story.title: Europe Quiz
story.ctaText: How many did you get? Comment 👇

questions.q: Which river flows through **Vienna** and Budapest?
What money do they use in **Switzerland**?
What is the highest mountain in the **Alps**?

lines.q: Which river flows through Vienna and Budapest?
lines.a: The Danube! It runs through four capital cities, more than any other river.

lines.q: Which country does not border Germany?
lines.a: Hungary! Germany has nine neighbours, but Hungary is not one of them.

lines.q: What money do they use in Switzerland?
lines.a: The Swiss franc! Right in the middle of Europe, and still no euro.

lines.q: What is the highest mountain in the Alps?
lines.a: Mont Blanc! Almost four thousand eight hundred metres. The famous Matterhorn is shorter.

lines.q: Which strait separates Spain from Morocco?
lines.a: Gibraltar! At its narrowest, Africa is only about fourteen kilometres away.

lines.q: Last one. Liechtenstein lies between which two countries?
lines.a: Switzerland and Austria! And it has no coast at all. Got all six? Go again!
